title: The Slow Archive
author: Beatrix Marchetti
blurb: Sable Yarrow, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
